author: SnowSX3
body:
Reported Player(s): cheesehead235
Rules Broken: Excessive Team Griefing.
Evidence: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FA08-7fZHUs&feature=youtu.be

Right before recording, I used the anvil that can be seen on the ground at the start of the video to make a sharpness 3 sword, but because he broke it and item don't drop, I lost 2 sharpness 2 swords.

I understand that this player has already been temporarily banned for one day for team griefing but I'm requesting that it be extended due to the fact that this evidence was recorded a few minutes before the infraction was dealt.

Please ignore the NZ radio that I'm listening to xD

Regards,
Snow.
